properties.name: Arcadia Planitia Ice Sheet
pros: Massive shallow subsurface water-ice sheet mapped by NASA SWIM & SHARAD
Low elevation (-3.9 km) and remarkably flat smooth plains
Mid-latitude (39.2°N) balances accessible water ice with usable sunlight
risks: Seasonal frost and northern storm fronts
resources: High-purity subsurface water ice (<1–3 m depth)
Flat volcanic plains ideal for starship landing pads
Abundant atmospheric CO2 + water for in-situ propellant (ISRU)
properties.source: NASA SWIM (Subsurface Water Ice Mapping) / MRO SHARAD

properties.name: Utopia Planitia Ice Deposit
pros: Contains more subsurface water ice than Lake Superior (50–85% water ice by volume)
Deep basin (-4.4 km) provides maximum atmospheric braking & radiation protection
risks: Higher latitude (43.5°N) reduces winter solar efficiency
resources: Vast buried water-ice deposit (1–10 m overburden)

properties.name: Deuteronilus Mensae Lobate Glaciers
pros: Debris-covered glaciers containing nearly pure buried water ice
Natural mesa cliffs offer potential cave/alcove radiation shelter
risks: Rugged mesa edges require precision landing on valley floors
Rockfall hazard near steep fretted terrain walls
resources: Glacial water ice beneath thin rocky debris apron
Natural terrain shielding against solar particle events
